_about: THE MARKS (WORDS THREE 11/20; rule 455). For an OPEN mouth only (records/words_two/the_voice_switch.json): every new or rewritten line's reading, {"line": the line exactly as the game holds it, "scary": "desperate" | "a threat" | "eerie" | "cold", "second": his second word or null, "his": a VOTE card id when the line is one of his own, "by": who marked it}, under the mouth's name. A machine cannot hear scary, so a person marks it and gates/the_voice_holds_gate.py holds the mark to the line. Empty: no mouth is open.
